title: PATCH /v1/rooms/{room}/devices/{asset} request body
description: Move a device or substitute its model (the position keeps its id and its model history; in an installed room under recommissioning the unit of the previous model is taken out — SUBSTITUTED, its history kept — and a unit of the new model, new or a spare `asset`, is installed in the same transaction; `expectedInstallation` refuses a stale change with 409)
